July 5, 2025
Claim reported by the insured's counsel after a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. Injury

Reviewed the insured's policy and confirmed the driver involved is named on it. Coverage was in force at the time of

July 20, 2025
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the scene and describes the lane-change
contact between the two cars.
July 28, 2025
Took the recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of how the collision happened matched
the first report in every detail.
August 20, 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who independently described the same lane change and contact between the vehicles.
Their account agrees with the claimant's.
August 31, 2025
Reviewed the scene photographs and two witness statements. Both witnesses and the images are consistent with
the sideswipe as described.
September 6, 2025
Inspected the claimant's vehicle. The damage pattern along the side panels lines up with the impact described, and
no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or records.
September 30, 2025
Received the medical records from the treating provider. The neck and back strain diagnosis fits the kind and force of
a side impcat at this speed, and no prior injury to those body areas is on file.
November 9, 2025
Treatment followed a typical course of physical therapy and follow-up visits. The provider's notes show steady
improvement, and the frequency of visits tapered as the claimant recovered.
November 14, 2025
Counsel confirmed the claimant has been attending the scheduled therapy and that the remaining symptoms are
mild. Requested updated treatment notes to confirm the current status.
December 12, 2025
Reviewed the updated notes. Treatment has tapered to periodic check-ins, consistent with the expected recovery
timeline for this type of strain.
January 4, 2026

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
